remarks: Set on a level one acre lot along a private road in desirable Newfield neighborhood, 3 Megan Lane pairs classic Colonial curb appeal with a spacious, modern interior designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The expansive main level features generously proportioned rooms, three fireplaces, formal living and dining rooms, and a flexible den or home office. At the heart of the home is the impressive family room, highlighted by soaring 14+ foot vaulted ceilings and a wall of sliding glass doors opening to the large rear deck. Multiple entertaining spaces enjoy direct deck access, creating an easy indoor/outdoor flow overlooking the private grounds.Thoughtful conveniences include abundant storage, a dedicated laundry room, and direct garage access just off the kitchen.  Upstairs, four bedrooms and three full baths offer exceptional space and privacy. The primary suite is truly impressive, with an expansive footprint that includes a dedicated dressing room and an oversized bath with room for both a shower & whirlpool tub. Two additional bedrooms offer ample closet space and share a full hall bath, while the fourth bedroom enjoys its own ensuite bath and walk-in closet, ideal for guests or extended family.  Offering convenient access to nearby shopping, dining, schools, and everyday amenities. Megan Lane is a rare combination of space, privacy, and accessibility.
